notes: The upper summation connector's terminal is copied as a perpendicular bar without inferring a new mathematical operator or changing the summation label. Its literal form differs from both witnesses' explicit arrowheads.

The cancelled final Sigma in the exterior-product explanation belongs below the inner closer, outside O_Sigma(omega)'s argument and inside the large prose parenthesis. The historical lower-index placement changes; the live formula is unchanged.
The separator in fibré tangent : Sigma is a literal colon. The two dark points do not support the à supplied by both witnesses.

The detached dash after mineurs is preserved at its physical position before the next line de la matrice. Its function is unstated. No lexical hyphen, omitted word or continuation semantics is supplied.

A candidate equality sign after R_i was rejected on the existing r_definition crop: a thin curved left stroke joins the two thick arms, confirming subset rather than equality. This creates no change row.
The lower checked-Omega underline and the nearby curved contour around the inserted tilde R_i are distinct strokes. The existing underline and contour are retained without duplicating either.

The existing differences among ordinary V(J), the doubled/reworked R/Q ambient glyphs, P and checked V, and lower omega versus capital Omega are retained. Alphabet doubt at the two ambient-space glyphs remains; no new font-only finding is introduced.

All sixteen existing uncertainties remain after direct examination of the relevant source locations: the crossed closer, inserted digit, crossed round signs and coefficient, overworked minus, cancelled cyclic indices, two ambient glyphs and the small O subscript, inserted omega-index equality, cancelled classe-de expression, layered phi revisions, old lower omega/inverse labels and the two short cancellations near racine/on prendra.
